name: initpad
description: InitPad – interní platforma pro vývojáře (IDP), prototyp k diplomové práci

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @initpad/api && npm run build --workspace @initpad/web && npm run build --workspace @initpad/agent && npm run build --workspace @initpad/supervisor
scripts.test: npm run test:release-tools && npm run test --workspace @initpad/api -- --runInBand && npm run test --workspace @initpad/web && npm run test --workspace @initpad/agent && npm run test --workspace @initpad/supervisor
scripts.check: npm run audit:repo && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run build && npm run test
scripts.check:release: npm run check && npm run audit:dependencies
